name: Why didn't you call?
source:
Why didn't you call? 

These words repeat themselves in Theo's mind after she meets again with a one-night stand while admitted to a hospital for being attacked by a mysterious group.

She will now have to deal with the consequences of her attack, her feelings for detective Perpetva and the question. Who attacked her and why?

[From [url=https://tangledvirus.itch.io/why-didnt-you-call]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你为什么不打电话？

西奥因遭到神秘团体袭击而住院期间，再次遭遇一夜情，这句话在她脑海中不断重复。

她现在必须应对袭击的后果、她对佩佩特瓦警探的感情以及这个问题。谁袭击了她，为什么？

[来自[url=https://tangledvirus.itch.io/why-didnt-you-call]Itch.io[/url]]
